faqs.q: What are Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes used for?
faqs.a: U-tubes bent from ASTM A179, A214 and A556 carbon steel tube, for removable-bundle shell-and-tube exchangers and feedwater heaters, to your bend schedule. It is listed in 40 sizes, 15.88–50.8 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes, such as IH-TF-UC-CS-0159-124?
faqs.a: Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes part numbers begin with IH-TF-UC-CS and then give the outside diameter in tenths of a millimetre and the wall thickness in hundredths of a millimetre. IH-TF-UC-CS-0159-124 is 15.88 mm outside diameter by 1.24 mm wall, and IH-TF-UC-CS-0508-340 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.

faqs.q: What sizes do Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes come in?
faqs.a: Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes are listed in 40 sizes, 15.88–50.8 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-UC-CS-0159-124 and IH-TF-UC-CS-0508-340. The table includes 15.88 mm OD by 1.24 mm wall and 50.80 mm OD by 3.40 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity, with the bend schedule. Centreline radius and leg length for each row, and any heat treatment of the bends. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: How tight can the bends be on Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes?
faqs.a: The bend radius for Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes: 1.5×OD centreline radius available; dimensional tolerances guaranteed from 2×OD.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes?
faqs.a: For Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes, testing follows the governing standard: Straight-tube tests per base specification. Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes are available in these grades: A179; A192; A210; A214; A556. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes?
faqs.a: Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes are made to ASTM A179, ASTM A214, ASTM A556, ASTM A450, ASME SA178, ASME SA192, ASME SA210. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes, U-tubes go into the tube sheet of a removable-bundle exchanger at both ends and are held by baffles or support plates, so the bend schedule must match the bundle layout. Related ranges are the [Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes](/c/alloy-steel-u-bend-tubes) and [Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes](/c/copper-alloy-u-bend-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: How are Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes shipped, and can they be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
